always_weak.label: Always Cheap
always_weak.description: Every query goes to the cheap tier; no judge needed in production.

always_mid.label: Always Mid
always_mid.description: Every query goes to the mid tier.

always_strong.label: Always Strong
always_strong.description: Every query goes to the strong tier (quality ceiling / cost reference).

static_router.label: Static Router
static_router.description: Heuristic difficulty routing; no judge-driven escalation.

smart_router.label: SmartRouter
smart_router.description: Heuristic routing + answer checks + judge-driven escalation.

claim.explanation: SmartRouter is cheaper than Always Strong without a measurable accuracy loss, but Always Cheap matches it for less money, so routing adds cost without a measurable benefit on this dataset (strict accuracy SmartRouter 96.7%, Always Cheap 90.0%, Always Strong 96.7%; cost incl. judge 5.93 vs 0.97 vs 10.00; paired vs cheap 3 wins / 1 losses (p=0.625)).
